rules.statement: Duty under the Stamp Duty Act is payable only on the principal amount and not on the interest accrued thereon.
rules.supporting_quote: Sections 16 and 17 of the Stamp Duty Act have to be interpreted strictly. It is clear that duty is payable only on the principal amount and not on the interest. The mortgage must be stamped to the value of the principal sum only, and no stamp duty is required to be paid on the interest payable. It is untenable to say no interest could be recovered

meta.parties: Dayarathne v. State Mortgage And Investment Bank
